title: Jthurston and Joyrizer releases a new Single "Love is Gone" together from EP "We Are Not Them"
htmlContent:
Jthurston and Joyrizer releases a new EP together called “We Are Not Them,” which contains 8 solid songs leading by "Love is Gone." Love is Gone is the type of song people talk about when they say an artist gives you everything. 

Jthurston and Joyrizer's "Love is Gone" is that music that is so real you take on the emotion of it whether thats how you feel or not. They give their all to the music, and thats what helps you buy into their sound, as they bring their all with no limits to get us through, to show the full power of music.
